what: Claude slot writes .done before parent can write .stderr-tail
scenario_or_breakage: wait-for-reviewers unblocks on subprocess .done while launch-claude-review still runs post-rc work; collector dedup can skip a missing sidecar for real failures
suggested_fix: Write .stderr-tail in launch-claude-subprocess.sh immediately before .done (source ${OUTPUT}.stderr), or defer .done until the parent finishes the tail write
